I built a fully working PC inside a mouse!

About this project:
What if your mouse was actually a PC? 

In this project, I took the motherboard and internals from an old smartphone and packed them inside a mouse to create a fully working mini PC. And yes… it can run Minecraft! 😎

This crazy DIY electronics project also features Samsung DeX, custom brass cooling, and a lot of modifications to make everything fit inside.
Would you use a mouse like this? 👀
